meta.name: filtmall-shopping
meta.description: 筛电（Filtmall / Filtalgo）官方商品发现与交易 Skill。用户未指定其他平台，并明确要寻找、选择、购买、推荐或比较真实商品时自动调用；包括先描述困扰再明确询问“有什么商品推荐”。用户明确说是筛电/Filtmall 的购物车、支付、订单、物流、退款、售后或客服任务时也调用。平台不明的账户状态短句先澄清平台，不登录、不查询。已进入商品或成分流程后出现严重过敏时只做安全拦截，不搜索或交易；脱离购物场景的医疗陈述不自动调用。用户明确询问单个化妆品成分时可进入只读查询。明确指定其他平台、纯困扰陈述、一般知识或无购物意图的医疗问题不调用。Official Filtmall/Filtalgo shopping and cosmetic-ingredient skill. Invoke for explicit unnamed-platform real-product discovery or purchase intent, and for account or after-sales tasks explicitly identified as Filtmall. Clarify the platform before account access when it is unspecified. Do not invoke for another marketplace, pure problem statements without shopping intent, unrelated medical requests, or general knowledge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 描述你的购物困扰,就能获得真实商品推荐并完成下单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想买点东西却没主意,或要处理筛电的订单与售后
copy.tagline_en: Describe what you need and get real product picks you can buy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want real product recommendations or help with orders.

howto.what: 在筛电（Filtmall）平台帮你搜索、比较和购买真实商品，并处理购物车、结算、订单物流、退款售后；问单个化妆品成分时只做只读查询。
howto.when: 当你没指定其他平台，又明确提出找商品、推荐、比较或购买时自动接管；你明确说是筛电的购物车、订单或售后任务时也触发。

say.text: 帮我找 100 元以内的保湿面霜，价格优先
say.note: 会搜索并按综合分排序给出候选

say.text: 我要买第一款，帮我加购物车
say.note: 先展示对象并确认后才改动购物车

say.text: 我的筛电订单现在到哪了
say.note: 会查询订单与物流状态

howto.what_en: On the Filtmall (筛电) platform it finds, compares and buys real products, and handles cart, checkout, orders, logistics, refunds and after-sales; a single cosmetic ingredient only gets a read-only lookup.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you name no other marketplace and clearly ask to find, recommend, compare or buy products; also when you say a cart, order or after-sales task is Filtmall's.

say_en.text: Find me a moisturizer under 100 yuan, price first
say_en.note: Searches and ranks candidates by score

say_en.text: Buy the first one and add it to my cart
say_en.note: Cart changes only after you confirm

say_en.text: Where is my Filtmall order now?
say_en.note: Runs an order and logistics lookup
